app.name: PureProjects
app.description: Track knowledge-work projects: deliverables with dates and owners, the next action, what you are waiting on, and the documents each project pulls together.

tools.name: getProjectsContext
tools.description: Overview of the user's projects: totals by status, what is overdue, what is waiting on someone, and which projects have no next action. Call this first to see where the work stands before answering anything about projects.

tools.name: listProjects
tools.description: List projects with their status, next action, people, due date and area. Filter by status, area, or a free-text query. Use before proposing changes so ids and current values are exact.

archived.description: List archived projects instead of live ones. Archived projects are out of view by default.

query.description: Free-text match on name, next action, or people.

tools.name: getProject
tools.description: One project in full: description, deliverables with owners and due dates, journal entries, linked documents, and what it is waiting on.

tools.name: createProject
tools.description: Create a project. Name it the way the user refers to it. Set area, due date and next action when they are known - a project with no next action is the state that quietly kills knowledge work.

summary.description: One or two sentences on what this project is.

area.description: Grouping such as Writing, Clients, Admin.

dueAt.description: ISO date the project is due.

tools.name: updateProject
tools.description: Change a project's status, next action, due date, area, summary or people. Only the fields you pass are changed.

dueAt.description: ISO date, or an empty string to clear it.

tools.name: addDeliverable
tools.description: Add a deliverable to a project: a concrete thing that gets finished, with an owner and a due date.

owner.description: Who owes it. Omit for the user.

tools.name: updateDeliverable
tools.description: Complete, reopen, retitle or re-date a deliverable.

done.description: true completes it, false reopens it.

tools.name: setWaitingOn
tools.description: Record that a project is waiting on someone, or clear a wait that arrived. Waits stack: passing person ADDS one. Passing resolveWaitingId clears that one; passing neither clears them all. The status follows the list — the project is 'waiting' while any remain and returns to 'active' when the last clears.

person.description: Who owes it. Adds a wait — a project can be waiting on several people at once, so this never replaces an existing one.

askedAt.description: ISO date they were asked. Defaults to today.

resolveWaitingId.description: Id of the wait that arrived (waitingId from listProjects/getProject). Omit both this and person to clear every outstanding wait.

tools.name: logJournalEntry
tools.description: Append a dated entry to a project's journal: a decision made, a milestone reached, something that changed. The journal is append-only and is the project's memory - write what a colleague would need to understand the decision months later, not a list of activity.

body.description: Two or three sentences of substance.

tools.name: createDocument
tools.description: Write a new document for a project. Creates a real PureWriter .document package in PureDocuments and links it to the project, so the user can open it here or in Writer, and other agents can find it through context search. Use this when the user asks for notes, a brief, an outline or a draft that belongs to a project - not for content that belongs in the journal.

title.description: Document title; also the package name.

html.description: Optional initial content as simple HTML (h1/h2/p/ul/ol/blockquote). Omit for an empty document with a heading.

tools.name: readDocument
tools.description: Read a linked .document package as a numbered list of blocks. Call this before editing one: block indexes are how the edit tools address content, and they shift after every insert or delete.

path.description: The document's path, as listed on the project by getProject.

tools.name: insertDocumentBlock
tools.description: Add a block to a linked document. Pass html for prose, or mermaid for a diagram - give the diagram source only (for example 'graph TD; A --> B;') and it is wrapped as a diagram the editor renders. Defaults to the end of the document.

mermaid.description: Mermaid diagram source. Use instead of html for a diagram.

at.description: Where to put it. Defaults to end.

index.description: The block to insert before or after. Required unless at is end.

tools.name: replaceDocumentBlock
tools.description: Replace one block of a linked document, leaving the rest untouched. Pass html, or mermaid to make the block a diagram.

tools.name: deleteDocumentBlock
tools.description: Delete one block of a linked document. Removing a block discards its content - to reword something use replaceDocumentBlock instead.

tools.name: exportDocumentsPdf
tools.description: Convert a project's documents to PDF, written beside each document in the workspace. Only documents created in this app can be converted; files attached to the project are already whatever they are and are reported as skipped. Omit paths to convert every document on the project.

paths.description: Document paths from getProject. Omit for all of them.

tools.name: exportProjectZip
tools.description: Bundle a project's documents into a zip in the workspace Documents folder. Documents created here go in as PDFs; attached files go in as themselves. The result returns the saved path.

paths.description: Document paths from getProject. Omit for all of them.

tools.name: reorderProject
tools.description: Move a project in the list. The list keeps the arrangement afterwards rather than sorting by urgency, so only do this when the user asks for an order - not to tidy.

targetProjectId.description: Required when at is before or after.

tools.name: linkDocument
tools.description: Attach reference material to a project: a document or other resource in the workspace, or a page on the web by its address.

label.description: How it should read in the list.

path.description: Workspace path of the resource, or an https:// address for a page on the web.

kind.description: document, mail, event, or web. Optional — an http(s) path is treated as web regardless.

tools.name: archiveProject
tools.description: Put a project out of view without losing anything. Its status, deliverables, waits, journal and documents all stay exactly as they are, and it can be made active again at any time. This is what to do with work that is finished, abandoned or parked - prefer it over deleteProject, which destroys the record.

archived.description: true to archive, false to bring it back into view. Defaults to true.

tools.name: deleteProject
tools.description: Delete a project permanently, with its deliverables, journal and links. This cannot be undone - prefer archiveProject, which puts it out of view and keeps the whole record. Only delete when the user asks to remove something outright.

name.description: The project's exact current name, as a guard against deleting the wrong one.

tools.name: removeDeliverable
tools.description: Remove a deliverable from a project. To mark one finished use updateDeliverable with done - removing it discards the record that it existed.

tools.name: moveDeliverable
tools.description: Move a deliverable to another project, unchanged: same title, owner, date and done state. The source project forgets it (and its next action, if that was it); the target lists it last. Use getProject for deliverable ids and listProjects for project ids.

projectId.description: The project the deliverable is in now.

tools.name: removeLink
tools.description: Unlink a document, mail thread or event from a project. The document itself is untouched - only the link is removed.
